26:3: You are to come to the kohein
who will be [of service] during those days
and you will say to him, ‘‘I ascertain today before Adonoy, your God,
that I have arrived in the land
that Adonoy swore to our forefathers to give us.’’
26:5: And you shall then proclaim and say before Adonoy, your God, ‘‘Lovon the Aramite wanted to destroy my forefather,
and sojourned there with a small nation;
and there he became a great people, powerful and numerous.
26:7: ‘‘We prayed before Adonoy, God of our forefathers,
and it was revealed before Him, our oppression, and our labor, and the pressure upon us.
26:11: You shall rejoice with all the good that Adonoy, your God, gave you and the members of your household;
and the proselyte in your midst.
26:13: You shall declare before Adonoy, your God, ‘‘I have divested my estate of the sacred tithe, and I have also presented it to the Levi and also to the proselyte, the orphan, and the widow,
totally according to Your command that You commanded me;
I did not transgress any of Your commandments nor did I forget.
26:14: I did not eat of it when grieving, nor did I devour it when ritually defiled,
nor did I make use of it for the dead;
I have accepted the word of Adonoy, my God;
I have fulfilled everything that You commanded me.
26:17: to be a God for you and to go in the ways which are proper before Him and to guard His statutes and His commandments and His laws, and to accept His word.
26:19: And to place you superior to all the nations whom He made,
for praise and for renown and for glory,
and so that you may be a people sanctified before Adonoy, your God, as He said.
27:5: do not lift iron upon them.
27:6: [Of] whole stones are you to build
the altar of Adonoy, your God;
and you are to bring upon it burnt-offerings
27:7: You are to slaughter sacred-offerings and eat [them] there;
and you are to rejoice in the presence of Adonoy, your God.
27:9: [On] this day you have become a people
27:10: You are to accept the word of Adonoy, your God,
and perform His commandments and His statutes
that I am commanding you today.’’
27:13: And the following will stand for the curse[rs] at Mount Eival:
27:15: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a statue or a molten image, distanced before Adonoy, the handiwork of a craftsman, and places [it] in a secret [place];’
the entire people will respond and say, Amein.
27:17: ‘Cursed is whoever changes the boundary of his fellow;’
and the entire people will say, Amein.
28:1: When you truly accept the word of Adonoy, your God,
to be sure to perform all of His commandments
that I am commanding you today;
Adonoy, your God, will place you superior
to all the nations of the earth.
28:2: All these blessings will come upon you and will adhere to you,
28:4: Blessed is the offspring of your belly, and the fruit of your soil, and the offspring of your animals,
the issue of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep and goats.
28:7: Adonoy will set your enemies who rise against you
by one road will they approach you,
but by seven roads they will flee from you.
28:9: Adonoy will establish you for Himself as a holy people
when you will guard the commandments of Adonoy, your God,
and will go in the ways that are correct before Him.
28:11: Adonoy will give you surplus as benefit
in the offspring of your belly, and the offspring of your animals, and the fruit of your soil;
that Adonoy swore to your forefathers to give you.
28:13: Adonoy will place you to be powerful, not to be weak;
and you will be solely on top,
you will not be on the bottom;
when you heed the commandments of Adonoy, your God, that I am commanding you today to guard and to perform.
28:14: And you do not deviate from all the statements that I am commanding you today to the right or to the left,
to follow idols of the nations to serve them.
28:15: Should you not accept the word of Adonoy, your God,
to guard to perform all His commandments and His statutes
that I am commanding you today;
then all these curses will come upon you and will cleave to you.
28:18: Cursed is the offspring of your belly and the fruit of your soil,
the calves of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep and goats.
28:20: Adonoy will visit upon you ruin, panic, and frustration
in all the endeavors you undertake,
until you are destroyed and until you are swiftly removed
because of the wickedness of your deeds [in] that you forsook the fear of Me.
28:23: And the heavens above your head will be unyielding like copper in withholding rain
and the earth that is beneath you, as strong as iron so as not to bear fruit.
28:25: Adonoy will set you broken before your enemies.
By one road will you go out toward them
and by seven roads will you flee before them;
and you will be a cause of shuddering
for all the kingdoms of the earth.
28:26: for food for every bird of the sky and for the animals of the earth;
28:32: Your sons and your daughters [will be] given to another people while your eyes watch
and pine because of them all day,
28:34: from the sights that you see.
28:35: Adonoy will plague you with bad boils on the knees and on the legs
from which you will be unable to be healed;
from the sole of your foot till your brain.
28:36: Adonoy will exile you and your king, whom you will set upon yourself,
to a nation that neither you nor your parents knew;
and there you will serve nations worshipping idols [of] wood and stone.
28:40: Olives will you have within your entire boundary,
but oil will you not anoint
28:43: will rise above you higher and higher,
while you descend lower and lower.

to guard His commandments and His statutes that He commanded you.
28:47: Since you did not serve before Adonoy, your God,
28:48: You will serve your enemies whom Adonoy will set against you,

and he will set an iron yoke upon your neck
28:51: They will consume the offspring of your animals, and the fruit of your soil until you are destroyed;

28:52: They will make you suffer in all your cities until capturing your ramparts and fortified walls

they will make you suffer in all your cities

that Adonoy, your God, gave you;
in the siege and in the distress
that your enemy will distress you.
28:54: [even] he will look askance at his brother and at the wife of his covenant
and at the rest of his sons whom he will leave over.
28:56: The soft female among you and the indulged one the sole of whose foot never experienced being put on the ground
out of indulgence and out of softness;
her eye will begrudge the husband of her covenant,
28:57: And her little children who emerge from her, and her children whom she bears,

that your enemy will distress you in your cities.
28:62: like the stars in the sky, multitudinous;
28:63: It will happen that as Adonoy rejoiced over you to benefit you and to multiply you,
so will Adonoy bring joy to others over you
to remove you and to destroy you;
and you will be carried away from upon the land
that you are coming there to inherit.
28:64: Adonoy will disperse you among all the peoples
from the end of the earth to the end of the earth;
and you shall serve there nations who serve idols which neither you nor your ancestors knew, wood and stone.
28:66: and you will be afraid night and day,
and will have no faith in your living.
28:67: In the morning you will say, ‘‘Would that it were evening,’’
and in the evening you will say, ‘‘Would that it were morning,’’
from the fright in your heart that you will be afraid
and from the sights of your eyes that you will see.
28:68: Adonoy will send you back to Egypt on ships,
along the route that I told you,
‘‘You are not to see it again,’’
and there you will be sold to your enemies as slaves and as maidservants but no one will buy.
